subject: Re: VPC/on‑prem packaging — commitment tiers & crediting playbook
messages:
From: Diego Torres <diego@brightmed.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightmed.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC/on-prem RFP — initial ask

Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — attaching our RFP (BrightMed_RFP_20260510.pdf). BrightMed is evaluating a HIPAA-compliant VPC/on‑prem deployment for our inference workloads. High-level:
- Target start: Q3 2026
- Expected sustained throughput: ~250M tokens/month, peaks ~2.5k QPS inference for short bursts
- Model mix: a mix of open Llama-derivatives and a couple of GPL-compatible fine-tuned models (up to 32B)
- Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA; customer-managed keys preferred
- Preference: 36-month term with predictable unit economics

Questions we need answered for procurement:
1) How do you structure the platform fee vs. per-token/meters for private deployments?
2) Do you have an established support tier pricing for on‑prem (SLA, 24/7 oncall, dedicated CSM)?
3) Any migration/onboarding credits for multi-year commitments?
4) Are there options to amortize license/platform fees across the term?

We are hoping to get a commercial picture to bring to legal and procurement by the end of May.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Diego
VP Engineering, BrightMed Health
attachments: BrightMed_RFP_20260510.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Diego Torres <diego@brightmed.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightmed.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem RFP — initial ask

Hi Diego — thanks for the RFP and context, appreciate the level of detail. Quick answers up front, then a suggested next step: 

1) Platform fee vs usage: For private VPC/on‑prem we typically combine a one-time onboarding fee (covers packaging + validation) + an annual platform fee that covers the private control plane, telemetry, and security integrations. Usage (token/embedding units) is billed on a metered basis on top of that. We can offer amortization of the platform fee across the committed term as a billing option (common for 24–36 mo deals).

2) Support tiers: Bronze (business hours, ticket SLAs), Silver (24x5 oncall + monthly reviews + named CSM), Gold (24x7 oncall, incident bridging, faster response SLAs, quarterly architecture reviews). We price Gold for enterprise/regulated use cases; I'll share a matrix.

3) Migration/onboarding credits: We do provide migration credits tied to multi-year commits. Typical structure: partial waiver of onboarding fee + up to X months of free migration support if you hit minimal capacity commitments within Q1 post-launch.

4) Amortization: yes — either amortized monthly invoices or consolidated annual billing; legal/finance prefers amortization for capitalized costs.

Next step: I've attached a short VPC_pricing_matrix_v1.pdf to show typical bundles (platform fee bands, commit tiers, and support tie-ins). Can we set a 30-min call this week to align on committed baseline and compliance requirements? Also: one clarifying item — are you asking for customer-managed HSM or just KMS integration?

If you prefer, we can draft a commercial offer with a playbook for credits/conditional discounts so procurement has something tangible.

Best,
Hannah
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: VPC_pricing_matrix_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: BrightMed — concession ask and draft playbook (need approval)

Marcus / Laura — looping you both in. BrightMed sent an RFP asking for: 25% platform fee waiver year 1 + 6 months free migration support + 36-mo term. They propose a committed baseline of ~250M tokens/mo.

My recommended counter: 
- Offer an amortized platform fee credit of 12% in year 1 (applied as monthly credit across invoices)
- Provide 3 months of migration support (on-site/remote mix) at no charge and waive onboarding fees up to $40k
- Add an attainment kicker: additional 5% platform fee credit if BrightMed reaches >=80% of committed baseline within 9 months
- Require a 24-36 month committed term and a minimum monthly committed tokens on a negotiated band (we should model a 250M and 350M band)

Quick financials (very rough):
- ARR impact (year 1 credit only): ~$(format) — see attached pricing_calc_breakdown.csv for the model (numbers are sensitive)
- Upside: with the kicker we recover most credits if they ramp on schedule

Questions for you: 
1) Marcus — are you comfortable approving 12% + attainment kicker and waived onboarding to $40k for a deal of this profile? This will be scaled in deal desk but want quick approval to present a commercial.
2) Laura — any redlines we should pre-clear in SOW around amortized platform fee and credit clawback if they terminate early? We should add explicit language for credit repayment on termination and SOW-based acceptance gates.

Goal: get internal OK and send a commercial offer with DocuSign link next week.

Thanks,
Hannah
attachments: pricing_calc_breakdown.csv (text/csv, 32KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightMed — concession ask and draft playbook (need approval)

Hannah — reviewed. Approve the commercial approach with the following guardrails: 
- Approve 12% year-1 amortized platform credit + 5% attainment kicker (kicker vests only if >=80% baseline achieved and sustained for 60 days)
- Approve waiving onboarding up to $40k and 3 months migration support. Any additional professional services billed at standard PS rates.
- Finance: credits must be modeled as liability on our books; include a credit-clawback clause if they early-terminate within first 12 months.
- Legal (Laura): please add SOW language: acceptance gates for production launch, credit clawback on early termination, and explicit definition of what counts as "migration support".

Hannah — proceed to produce a commercial offer. Include DocuSign and call out 30-day review/approval window for procurement. Also include the hubspot deal id HS-8421 on the cover page.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Diego Torres <diego@brightmed.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightmed.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood commercial — BrightMed VPC offer (HS-8421)

Diego — attaching our commercial offer and SOW (Redwood_VPC_Offer_BrightMed_20260522.pdf, Redwood_SOW_template.docx). Summary of the committed offer: 

- Term: 36 months
- Committed baseline: 250M tokens/month (banded pricing available if you want to step to 350M)
- Platform fee: annual platform fee, amortized monthly; we are offering a 12% platform fee credit in year 1 applied as monthly invoice credits
- Attainment kicker: additional 5% platform fee credit if BrightMed sustains >=80% of committed baseline within the first 9 months (kicker vests after 60 days at/above threshold)
- Migration/onboarding: waiver of onboarding fees up to $40,000 + 3 months migration support (remote + two onsite workshops) included; additional PS billed at standard rates
- Support: Silver tier included (24x5 oncall, named CSM). Gold upgrade available at list price (adds 24x7 and SLA-backed incident bridging)
- Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA support; we will integrate with your KMS/HSM per SOW

Next steps: 
1) Review the attached commercial PDF and SOW (we flagged amortization and credit-clawback language per Marcus/Laura guidance).
2) If acceptable, sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign/1234abcd (link live for 30 days).
3) We will schedule an onboarding kickoff within two weeks of signature (project plan attached in the SOW).

If you want, Marcus and I can join your procurement call next week to walk through the terms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_VPC_Offer_BrightMed_20260522.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB), Redwood_SOW_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 85KB)
